name: Jamie Sinclair
description: Rick's son, Merrick's older brother. Took personal responsibility for JD's discipleship after 2018. Analytical, direct, genuine. Met with JD for months. Specifically recommended David Zufall as a friend. Currently the gatekeeper for JD's CFC status — asked him not to attend until a formal decision is made. Last met a few months ago.
bio: Rick Sinclair's oldest son. Former pastor of CFC Canton. JD's primary pastor through the discipline process. Both are analytical, strategic thinkers — which created a specific problem: JD could always anticipate what Jamie was looking for and could never respond organically. In early 2026, Jamie asked JD not to return to CFC events until a formal decision is made. That decision remains pending.
